interpretation: All timed outputs and warmups validated against independent expected values
Single and empty-batch observations are startup/adapter dominated; batch100 remains an end-to-end process measurement
Canonical Rust has lower batch100 medians in all six cases; four of six native timing ranges overlap
Both scheduler variants show separated native batch ranges on this run; no instruction-level/native CPU-hotspot attribution
Python imports/startup dominate these small CLI workloads; do not interpret ratios as isolated function speedups
Hardware counters denied by host policy; native CPU-hotspot evidence unavailable
Memory figures are single outside-timing profiles, not repeated memory benchmarks
No HTTP load, Node.js comparison, language-wide ranking or self-hosting performance claim
